source.label: Placed in M66 as the app draws it, where the star's sight line crosses the disc's midplane: 10,310,408 pc (src/objects/m66-layers/source/recipe.json: centre 10,313,356 pc, inclination 57.3 deg, line of nodes 173.1 deg). The galaxy's distance, which places the galaxy and not a star within it: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 34695: distance modulus 30.067 ± 0.061 mag (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94)

controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Color of a blackbody at the star's temperature; darkening toward the edge from a model atmosphere. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The color of a blackbody at the star's published temperature. The darkening toward the edge is the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,770 K and log g 0.65 (u1 0.692, u2 0.086): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. The spin axis's direction on the sky is a display convention.
